description: SHUIN ジャンル別ビジュアル生成＆自己改善レジストリ。各ジャンルは独立した画材・色彩・構図ルールとマルチモーダル採点基準（rubric）、および学習済みブースター（self_improvement）を持ち、他ジャンルと干渉せずに進化する。

shin_hanga_twilight.label_ja: 新版画（川瀬巴水・吉田博風の宵景木版画）
shin_hanga_twilight.style_directive: Authentic early-20th-century Japanese Shin-Hanga woodblock print in the master tradition of Kawase Hasui and Hiroshi Yoshida. Deep saturated Prussian-blue and indigo twilight sky with hand-rubbed bokashi ink gradation, glowing warm amber paper lanterns and shoji window light, crisp carved sumi-black keyblock outlines, subtle visible cherry-wood grain texture in the flat pigment layers, poetic reflections on stone or water.
shin_hanga_twilight.eyecatch_composition: Atmospheric early-evening dusk perspective with rich foreground-to-midground depth, glowing warm interior/lantern lights contrasting against a deep indigo twilight sky filling the entire horizontal frame edge-to-edge.

rubric.must_have: Authentic woodblock print aesthetic (carved keyblock lines, bokashi sky/water color gradation, deep indigo/Prussian blue twilight contrasted with warm amber glow, full edge-to-edge bleed).
rubric.anti_patterns: Pale daytime brown-pen watercolor sketch, blank white margins around edges, photographic realism, fake kanji/text on lanterns or signs.

learned_boosters: Emphasize rich multi-block woodcut ink saturation and luminous amber lantern light against deep indigo dusk
Zoom tightly inside the woodblock image area itself edge-to-edge without any uncut collector washi margin or corner artist seal
learned_avoid: pale washed-out beige background
any pseudo-kanji strokes on lanterns or noren curtains
outer uncut ukiyo-e washi paper border or black rectangular keyblock frame
woodblock artist signature or hanko seal in bottom corners

history.note: 川瀬巴水調の深い藍の夜空ぼかし、濡れた石畳の琥珀灯反射と朱漆器の覗き見が白眉
無文字の暖簾と連子格子から漏れる灯りを広角アプローチ構図で表現
磨き込まれた縁側床への坪庭灯籠の映り込みと奥座敷の朱塗膳の空間演出
畳上の根来塗・黒江塗の朱と黒を真上90度フラットレイで木版調に構成
竹樋から湧く黒牛の名水と吊り灯籠のローアングル構図。版画外周余白の自動トリム則を追加
浄国寺石段から黒江の瓦屋根と湾を望む黄昏ぼかし。隅の落款防止ガードをv2に追加

risograph_vintage_poster.label_ja: ミッドセンチュリー・リソグラフ＆ヴィンテージ鉄道ポスター
risograph_vintage_poster.style_directive: Bold mid-century modern silkscreen and Risograph travel poster illustration inspired by 1950s Japanese National Railways posters and Swiss graphic art. Flat, high-impact screenprinted color planes using a curated palette of deep teal, burnt terracotta vermilion, mustard gold, midnight navy, and warm cream, with tactile soy-ink halftone grain texture and crisp graphic silhouettes, strictly artwork-only with zero typography.
risograph_vintage_poster.eyecatch_composition: Striking graphic poster composition with bold foreground silhouette shapes leading toward iconic architecture or landscape planes, full edge-to-edge color bleed with strong geometric contrast.

rubric.must_have: Flat graphic screenprint/risograph color planes, bold retro palette (teal, terracotta, mustard, navy), tactile halftone print grain, strong poster-like shape hierarchy.
rubric.anti_patterns: Fussy thin pen cross-hatching, pale watercolor washes, blank white vignette borders, ANY poster title text or typography.

learned_boosters: Use bold unoutlined flat screenprint color shapes with subtle risograph grain texture rather than fine ink linework
Bleed ink colors completely off all four canvas edges with zero outer poster trim, and simplify complex timber ceilings into flat screenprint shadow blocks
Use oversized foreground silhouettes and a receding path to anchor bold architectural color planes
learned_avoid: poster headline text or typography banners
thin brown pen-and-watercolor outlines
thin outer cream poster sheet border
dense comic-style woodgrain ink hatching on beams

history.note: ティール×テラコッタ×マスタードのシルクスクリーン色面と網点粒子が完璧
線路沿いの登り窯モチーフ建築を広角導入構図で表現、外周1.5%フチを自動除去
吹き抜け梁と斜光の幾何学コントラスト、遠景台座の備前水指の距離感が秀逸
厳密な真上90度フラットレイで従来45度器アップとの差別化に成功
古民家の大梁を見上げるダイナミック仰角。梁の線密度を抑える学習則をv2に追加
備前焼瓦の神門と狛犬を黄金色の夕景逆光で捉えたフィナーレ構図
朱色の陶器と煙突、青緑の空、黄土色の植生が版画的な色面と紙の粒子感で鮮やかにまとまり、四辺まで余白なく伸びる構図も力強い一方、屋根瓦の細部はやや密です。

ghibli_impasto_gouache.label_ja: 厚塗りポスターカラー＆ガッシュ風景美術（男鹿和雄風）
ghibli_impasto_gouache.style_directive: Lush, opaque Japanese animation background painting in Nicker poster color and thick gouache, inspired by Kazuo Oga. Expressive visible brushwork without ink outlines, luminous towering white cumulus clouds against a vibrant cerulean sky, rich layered foliage in emerald, viridian, and sunlit chartreuse, warm dappled sunlight and cool cobalt shadows.
ghibli_impasto_gouache.eyecatch_composition: Expansive cinematic landscape framing where lush nature, sky, clouds, and traditional architecture breathe together edge-to-edge across the entire canvas.

rubric.must_have: Opaque thick gouache/poster-color brushstrokes, zero ink outlines, rich saturated greens/blues and sunlit warmth, full edge-to-edge painted background.
rubric.anti_patterns: Thin pen-and-ink outlines, transparent pale washes leaving white paper margins, flat dull lighting.

learned_boosters: Paint entirely with opaque gouache brushstrokes and rich sunlit-to-shadow color temperature shifts, zero pen outlines
Layer opaque sunlit strokes over cool foliage shadows to strengthen depth and luminous summer atmosphere
Layer opaque foliage strokes with warm sunlit highlights and cool blue-green shadows for luminous depth
Layer opaque, broken-color brushstrokes with saturated stained-glass sunlight across wood, linen, and stone
learned_avoid: black or brown ink contour lines
unpainted white border fade

history.note: 不透明な厚塗りの筆致と鮮やかな緑・青、木漏れ日の暖かさが際立ち、白縁のない広角構図で社殿と参道と空を豊かに捉えているが、街路の文脈は控えめ。
不透明な厚塗りの筆致と鮮烈な緑・青、陽光の温かさが余白なく広がり、雲と建築も美しく調和しているが、手前の菓子がやや大きく風景の広がりを遮っている。
鮮やかな緑と青、不透明な筆致、木組み越しの庭園と床に伸びる格子影が美しく、四辺まで描き切られている一方、空間を貫く光芒はやや控えめです。
不透明な厚塗りと鮮烈な木漏れ日が全面を彩り、俯瞰の食卓も魅力的だが、グラスやカップの側面がやや見えすぎて厳密な真上視点からわずかに外れる。
不透明な厚塗りの筆致と鮮烈な緑・青、午後の暖光が際立ち、羊羹から奥へ導く対角線と軒の構図も秀逸だが、低位置からの見上げ感はやや控えめ。
不透明な厚塗りの筆致と濃密な緑・青、石段を染める黄金色の夕光が全面に広がり、見上げる社殿が旅の余韻を鮮やかに伝えている。

katazome_chigirie_folk.label_ja: 型染・和紙ちぎり絵フォークアート（民藝・芹沢銈介風）
katazome_chigirie_folk.style_directive: Traditional Japanese Mingei folk-art combining Katazome stencil dyeing and layered Chigiri-e hand-torn mulberry paper collage, inspired by Keisuke Serizawa. Tactile deckle-edged dyed paper fibers layered across the entire frame in rich mineral indigo, madder crimson, persimmon ochre, moss green, and warm dyed kozo paper tones, charmingly stylized decorative forms.
katazome_chigirie_folk.eyecatch_composition: Decorative, rhythmic folk-art composition with bold stylized motifs and layered dyed-paper textures extending completely to all four edges.

rubric.must_have: Tactile torn-paper collage edges and bold Katazome stencil folk-art stylization in rich Mingei mineral colors filling the frame.
rubric.anti_patterns: Photorealistic perspective rendering, generic watercolor sketch, white empty border margins, text characters.

learned_boosters: Repeat bold stencil motifs across layered, visibly torn dyed-paper shapes for rhythmic full-frame cohesion
Build silhouettes from visibly torn washi layers, pairing flat mineral-color fields with bold repeating stencil motifs
Build architectural planes from visibly torn washi shapes, unified by bold stencil motifs and saturated mineral colors
Layer fibrous torn-paper silhouettes with bold stencil patterns and saturated indigo, vermilion, and ochre
Emphasize irregular torn washi edges and overlapping paper layers within bold, flat stencil shapes
learned_avoid: standard architectural perspective pen drawing
kanji characters inside crests or banners

history.note: 濃密な朱・藍・黄土の配色と和紙のちぎり肌、反復する型染風の文様が四辺まで広がり、民藝らしい力強さがある一方、道の遠近感と蕎麦の細密さがやや写実寄りです。
和紙のちぎり肌と藍・朱・黄金の型染文様が鮮やかで、余白なく店構え・街路・屋根・空を捉えているが、建築の遠近と細部を少し平面化すると民藝らしさがさらに際立つ。
濃藍・朱・黄土の民藝的配色と型染文様、全面に広がる建築空間と斜光が魅力的だが、遠近と陰影がやや写実寄りで和紙のちぎり縁は弱い。
藍・朱・黄土の濃密な型染文様と和紙のちぎり肌が際立ち、余白のない画面に低位置からの軒と石畳の対角線、暖かな午後光が映えるが、建築の立体描写はやや写実寄り。
和紙の繊維とちぎり縁、藍・朱・黄土の型染文様が画面いっぱいに映え、真俯瞰の茶器と湯気も明快ですが、菓子の側面にはやや斜視が残ります。
濃密な民藝色と型染文様が四辺まで広がり、夕映えの社殿と石段が旅の余韻を伝える一方、ちぎり紙の毛羽立つ輪郭はやや控えめです。

cinematic_golden_hour.label_ja: シネマティック逆光・マジックアワー背景美術
cinematic_golden_hour.style_directive: Breathtaking modern Japanese theatrical animation background art with dramatic golden-hour sunset backlighting. Radiant amber-gold and rose-violet sky gradients, long atmospheric violet-blue shadows, warm rim-lighting catching roof tiles, foliage, steam, or water ripples, crisp specular reflections and emotional sense of place.
cinematic_golden_hour.eyecatch_composition: Dramatic low-sun backlit composition with glowing horizon sky, silhouetted architectural contours, and luminous reflections filling 100% of the wide canvas.

rubric.must_have: Strong golden-hour/sunset backlighting, glowing amber-violet color harmony, long dramatic shadows and rim light, full edge-to-edge bleed.
rubric.anti_patterns: Flat midday lighting, pale washed-out colors, sepia ink outlines, white margins.

learned_boosters: Maximize dramatic sunset rim-lighting and glowing violet-to-amber sky reflections across the full frame
learned_avoid: flat overhead noon lighting
white oval vignette fade

pictorial_isometric_map.label_ja: 鳥瞰アイソメトリック絵地図・箱庭イラスト
pictorial_isometric_map.style_directive: Charming 45-degree elevated bird's-eye isometric pictorial map and diorama illustration on warm antique buff-tinted cotton paper. Playful, finely detailed miniature overview of winding streets, rivers, bridges, trees, and signature buildings in warm sepia dip-pen lines with vibrant aquamarine, coral-vermilion, olive, and ochre washes extending organically across the textured paper sheet.
pictorial_isometric_map.eyecatch_composition: True elevated 45-degree bird's-eye miniature panorama looking down from above onto the interconnected townscape, waterways, and landmarks spanning widely across warm antique paper (NO cramped small central oval, NO street-level view, ZERO map labels or text).

rubric.must_have: Genuine 45-degree elevated bird's-eye / isometric miniature panorama on warm buff paper spanning broadly across the canvas, zero text labels.
rubric.anti_patterns: Eye-level street perspective, cramped tiny central vignette with huge empty white sides, map text/kanji labels or compass lettering.

learned_boosters: Keep camera high at a 45-degree bird's-eye miniature diorama angle spanning broadly across warm antique buff paper with zero text labels
learned_avoid: map legend boxes, compass letters, or place-name text
eye-level street perspective

nihonga_mineral_gold.label_ja: 近代日本画（東山魁夷風・岩絵具と金泥の静謐）
nihonga_mineral_gold.style_directive: Serene modern Nihonga mineral-pigment painting inspired by Kaii Higashiyama. Richly ground natural mineral pigments (deep azurite gunjo blue, malachite rokusho green, turquoise, cinnabar, and oyster-shell gofun white) with bands of drifting morning mist accented by subtle gold-dust (kinpun) shimmer, tranquil poetic stillness without pen outlines.
nihonga_mineral_gold.eyecatch_composition: Poetic, balanced horizontal composition with layered mist, tranquil reflections, or quiet architectural silhouettes immersed in deep mineral blues and greens edge-to-edge.

rubric.must_have: Matte mineral pigment texture (azurite blue, malachite green, subtle gold mist), serene Nihonga composition without ink outlines, full edge-to-edge bleed.
rubric.anti_patterns: Sketchy brown pen lines, busy cluttered cartoon details, stark white vignette borders.

learned_boosters: Use rich matte mineral azurite-blue and malachite-green planes with drifting golden mist and zero ink outlines
Layer matte mineral blues and greens with restrained gold mist to create depth without ink outlines
Layer granular azurite and malachite pigments beneath restrained gold mist, preserving matte surfaces and quiet tonal transitions
learned_avoid: sketchbook pen outlines
red artist hanko seal stamps or calligraphy

history.note: 群青と緑青の豊かな色彩、金泥を思わせる霞と静かな水面が日本画の静謐さを伝える一方、前景の壺と菓子はやや大きく風景の余韻を弱めています。
群青と緑青の粒状感、金泥を思わせる光、余白のない街並みの広角構図が美しく、店内の細密描写を少し抑えると日本画らしい静謐さがさらに深まります。
群青と緑青に金色の光が重なる岩絵具調の静謐さ、梁と窓が生む奥行きと長い影が秀逸ですが、床の反射はやや光沢が強めです。
岩絵具調の群青と緑、午後の金色光、低い視点から梁へ続く奥行きが魅力的だが、料理の細密描写と強い木部の陰影が日本画らしい静謐さをやや弱めている。
群青・緑青の粒状感と淡い金泥が静謐な日本画らしさを生み、余白なしの俯瞰構図も良好ですが、上部の瓦状構造に見える側面が厳密な真上視点をやや弱めています。
岩絵具を思わせる青緑の粒状感と金色の夕光、余白のない神社の遠景が美しい一方、絵馬の鮮やかな反復と細密描写が日本画らしい静謐さをやや弱めています。

fountain_pen_sketchbook.label_ja: 建築家の万年筆＆透明水彩フィールドスケッチ
fountain_pen_sketchbook.style_directive: Energetic architect's travel sketchbook illustration in Prussian-blue fountain-pen ink and expressive, spontaneous transparent watercolor splashes on tactile cold-press cotton paper (#F6F1E7). Lively gestural linework, dynamic cobalt-blue shadows and cadmium-orange/emerald color accents sweeping across the sketchbook sheet with authentic artist spontaneity.
fountain_pen_sketchbook.eyecatch_composition: Dynamic off-center diagonal or upward architectural perspective sweeping generously across 85%+ of the warm textured cotton paper with organic watercolor wash splashes (NOT a stiff symmetrical central oval).

rubric.must_have: Expressive Prussian-blue fountain-pen strokes and lively transparent watercolor splashes across warm cotton paper texture with dynamic composition.
rubric.anti_patterns: Stiff tiny centered oval vignette with blank 25% margins, dull brown-grey monochrome, handwritten notes or captions.

learned_boosters: Use Prussian-blue fountain-pen ink with bold cobalt shadows and vibrant watercolor splashes reaching generously across the cotton paper
learned_avoid: handwritten cursive notes or date signatures
tight oval vignette centered in empty white space

oil_palette_impasto.label_ja: 油彩インパスト・パレットナイフ風景画
oil_palette_impasto.style_directive: Expressive contemporary plein-air oil painting on canvas executed with bold palette-knife and bristle-brush impasto strokes. Rich tactile paint ridges, vibrant coloristic interplay of ultramarine, burnt sienna, cadmium yellow-ochre, crimson, and turquoise, dramatic light sculpting stone walls, tiled roofs, water, and sky.
oil_palette_impasto.eyecatch_composition: Bold painterly plein-air composition with sculpted impasto texture and strong light-and-shadow masses extending edge-to-edge across the entire canvas.

rubric.must_have: Visible thick impasto oil paint ridges and palette-knife brushwork covering 100% of the canvas with rich coloristic contrast.
rubric.anti_patterns: Thin watercolor washes, pen outlines, flat vector smoothness, white paper borders.

learned_boosters: Emphasize tactile palette-knife oil paint ridges and bold warm-versus-cool color impasto from edge to edge
Build architecture and reflections from broad palette-knife planes, reserving raised paint highlights for focal areas
Carry thick, directional palette-knife ridges through sky, water, and architecture while preserving distinct material textures
learned_avoid: pen linework or watery washes
picture frame mouldings around canvas

history.note: 全面を覆う厚塗りとナイフ状の筆致、鮮烈な青と朱の対比が目を引く一方、建物の細部はやや細密で大きな明暗の塊が弱まっています。
空から石畳まで厚塗りの絵具とナイフ状の筆致が鮮やかに貫かれ、建物・街路・屋根・空を収めた余白のない広角構図も良好だが、細部にはやや細かな描き込みが残る。
厚塗りの絵具とナイフ状の筆致、朱色と青紫の豊かな対比が建築の奥行きと長い影を際立たせているが、空間を横切る光芒はやや控えめ。
厚塗りの絵肌と藍・橙の鮮烈な対比、余白のない構図は秀逸ですが、桶の側面や室内の遠近感が強く、厳密な真上90度の俯瞰からやや逸れています。
厚塗りの絵肌と鮮烈な暖冷対比、軒や石壁が導く低位置の対角構図が秀逸で、奥の城だけがやや強く視線を奪う。
画面全域の厚塗りとパレットナイフ状の色面、石垣と水面を染める黄金の夕照が旅の終幕を鮮やかに伝える一方、橋の細部はやや整然としています。

pastel_chalk_morning.label_ja: 朝霧のソフトパステル＆色鉛筆ポエティック画
pastel_chalk_morning.style_directive: Luminous soft chalk-pastel and colored-pencil poetic illustration on warm oatmeal-tinted Ingres paper, inspired by fine European picture books. Velvety powdery gradients, gentle misty morning sunlight, harmonious palette of sage green, dusty coral-rose, lavender-blue, buttercream, and warm umber with tactile pastel grain.
pastel_chalk_morning.eyecatch_composition: Soft-focus atmospheric morning composition extending broadly across the warm tinted paper texture with gentle light diffusion and rich layered pastel strokes.

rubric.must_have: Velvety chalk-pastel and colored-pencil tooth texture on warm tinted paper, soft morning light harmony, zero hard ink outlines.
rubric.anti_patterns: Hard black/brown ink outlines, stark white background cutout, glossy digital airbrush look.

learned_boosters: Balance peach highlights with cool lavender morning haze, preserving visible pastel grain and colored-pencil tooth
Layer visible chalk grain with delicate colored-pencil hatching; preserve warm paper texture through luminous morning shadows
Preserve visible paper tooth and use cool lavender shadows to balance luminous peach and gold pastel light
Layer velvety chalk scumbling with delicate colored-pencil grain, preserving warm paper tooth and luminous cool accents
Layer broken chalk strokes and fine colored-pencil grain over warm paper, preserving soft luminous edges
learned_avoid: hard pen-and-ink outlines
stark white oval border

history.note: 温かな紙目に重なる柔らかなパステルと色鉛筆の質感、朝光の拡散が美しく、画面全体に広がる構図も魅力的ですが、建物の輪郭を少し和らげると朝霧の詩情がさらに深まります。
温かな紙肌にパステルと色鉛筆の柔らかな質感が広がり、建物・街路・空を収めた構図も良好ですが、朝霧より夕景に寄った桃色の光がやや強めです。
柔らかなパステルと色鉛筆の粒子感、梁と格子が導く奥行き、朝の光芒と長い影が美しく調和しているが、港側の霞を少し強めると朝霧の詩情がさらに深まる。
温かな紙地の粉状パステルと色鉛筆の質感が美しく、低い視点から梁と床が導く対角線の奥行きと午後の斜光も明確だが、全体の橙色を少し抑えると陰影の色彩がさらに際立つ。
温かな紙肌と柔らかなパステルの粒子、茶と器の彩りは魅力的ですが、器の側面や展望台模型が見える斜俯瞰で、必須の真上90度構図を満たしていません。
温かな紙目に重なるパステルと色鉛筆の柔らかな質感、夕映えの石畳と寺屋根が余韻を生む一方、前景の菓子が大きく景観の広がりはやや控えめです。
